youtube.title: 🎨 Your Agent Just Became a Design Studio
youtube.description: Tired of agents that forget your brand the second they restart? OpenDesign turns them into persistent design studios that remember your fonts, colors, and components across sessions. It works with DeepSeek, Claude Code, Cursor, and 23 other agents through a simple DESIGN.md file in your project directory. Comment the word 'open-design' and I'll send you the link and tutorial for this repo.

linkedin.text:
🎨 Your design handoffs shouldn't require a new tool

Every time you ask Claude, Cursor, or DeepSeek to generate a prototype, you're re-explaining your brand system. Colors. Fonts. Component rules. The same context, delivered fresh, because agents don't remember across sessions.

OpenDesign fixes that with one DESIGN.md file in your project directory.

✅ Your coding agents now read your brand system automatically
✅ Prototypes, decks, dashboards, and images arrive pre-styled
✅ Works with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 23 other CLI agents

It's the open-source Claude Design alternative — local-first, sandboxed preview, export to HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4, and zero vendor lock-in.

⭐ Already live on GitHub with native runtime adapters and MCP support for mainstream coding agents.

Search **nexu-io/open-design** on GitHub.

What's the most annoying part of your current design-to-dev handoff?
